sources: IRNA / ISNA (Iranian state media) via Reuters, Al Jazeera liveblog, Jerusalem Post

sections.what_happened: [ATTRIBUTED REPORT] Iranian state media (IRNA, ISNA) report explosions heard Saturday evening on Qeshm Island (two explosions, eastern side, first reported 19:51 GMT), near Jask port (several explosions, ~20:09 GMT), and in Sirik and Bandar Abbas. No official explanation of cause, no casualty or damage figures, no official Iranian or US confirmation of a strike. [ALLEGATION -- UNVERIFIED] Israeli Telegram channel Abu Ali Express, citing Iranian opposition channels and pro-axis channels, claims a US strike hit an anti-ship missile launcher at Jask; @GeoPWatch / @osintwarfare make the same claim; N12 reported Iranian media video of an explosion at Jask. ISNA suggested the blasts could be linked to Iranian military actions in the Strait of Hormuz. Context: earlier Saturday, Tasnim said two missiles struck Qeshm (the Friday-night US 'minor strikes' Trump confirmed, recorded totw-20261107-0700-01); the evening round is a separate, later set of reports. Reuters notes a US official said the earlier strikes were limited and not a resumption of major combat operations.
sections.what_verified: Reuters (T1) confirms Iranian media reported explosions on Qeshm and Jask with cause unclear; Al Jazeera liveblog (T2) carries the IRNA lines with timestamps; Jerusalem Post (T3) carries IRNA + ISNA including Sirik/Bandar Abbas. IRNA/ISNA are NOT in the source registry -- they do not count toward corroboration; the tiered carriers do.
sections.what_disputed: No US or Iranian official statement confirms a strike; ISNA itself frames the cause as possibly Iranian military action in the Strait; an Iranian state TV reporter suggested the sounds could be connected to Iranian defensive operations. Trump confirmed only the earlier Friday-night Qeshm strike as 'minor'. The earlier Friday-night event (0400-01/0700-01) shows explosions in the same area can have a US cause -- but that does not prove this round does.
sections.why_matters: Explosions rock Iran's Gulf coast -- Qeshm, Jask, Sirik, Bandar Abbas -- and nobody will say who did it. The explosions are confirmed; the US-strike claim is not. The Short must lead with the verified fact and label the strike claim UNVERIFIED.

totw_analysis: Our read: Explosions rock Iran's Gulf coast -- Qeshm, Jask, Sirik, Bandar Abbas -- and nobody will say who did it. The explosions are confirmed; the US-strike claim is not. The Short must lead with the verified fact and label the strike claim UNVERIFIED. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Who hit Jask -- a US strike on a missile launcher, or Iranian air defence at work? Is this the new round Trump warned about after the midterms, or Tehran's own fire?
